“Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”

Now when Daniel learned that the document had been signed, he went into his house, where the windows of his upper room opened toward Jerusalem, and three times a day he got down on his knees, prayed, and gave thanks to his God, just as he had done before.
So I turned my attention to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.

verses.text: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and pleas, and may You uphold their cause. May You forgive Your people who sinned against You.

xrefs.text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
then may You hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and may You uphold their cause.
but I am fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease. For I was a little angry, but they have added to the calamity.

verses.text: Now, my God, may Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.

xrefs.text: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to hear the prayer that I, Your servant, now pray before You day and night for Your servants, the Israelites. I confess the sins that we Israelites have committed against You. Both I and my father’s house have sinned.
A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.

O Lord, may Your ear be attentive to my prayer and to the prayers of Your servants who delight to revere Your name. Give Your servant success this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” (At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)

verses.text: Now therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. May Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness.

xrefs.text: I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool for our God. I had made preparations to build it,
For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—

They captured fortified cities and fertile land and took houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled; they grew fat and delighted in Your great goodness.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

verses.text: O LORD God, do not reject Your anointed one. Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David.”

xrefs.text: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
